title: M37 - upper-suite room packing and public-hall route search
status: bounded search found no candidate satisfying room contacts, lift keepout and required 4ft public routes to U-01, U-02 and U-04

search.algorithm: targeted U-03 root placement on each hypothetical shell edge, then deterministic tree-attached room placement and sampled public-route filtering
search.contact_sampling: Preserve the five legacy anchors; append the requested number of evenly spaced positions on each axis within the source 3.5ft door-reservation interval, snapped to the 1/6ft search grid.
search.public_door_edge_sample_basis: Hall reachability is tested at evenly spaced goal points along each room side, with each point kept at least half the source door-reservation interval from side corners. These are route samples only, not door locations or openings.

coordinate_basis.shell_case: M76-derived 38.333333 x 40 ft hypothetical upper-shell test envelope; unselected proposal, owner-authorized exploration only
coordinate_basis.note: Owner-authorized exploration of a M76 sensitivity case only; not a selected or approved building dimension.

preserved_constraints: U-01 to primary-only U-05 through a nominal 3.5ft contact reservation
owner-directed U-02 to U-03 private route only; no direct U-03 to C-UPPER door
owner-required direct U-02 shared-hall arrival; actual opening remains unmodeled
U-04 retains independent guest shared-hall access
U-03 and U-04 each contact U-06 for Jack-and-Jill access
source 8x8ft lift reservation, clipped to its upper-wing projection
4ft-wide hall route from source upper landing to U-01, U-02 and U-04; sampled side goals do not establish doors
limitations: The tree search is deterministic but bounded by NodeLimit/LayoutLimit and samples five contact-alignment anchors; it is not an exhaustive proof that no layout exists.
A 0.5ft gap represents a nominal wall allowance, and a 3.5ft edge reservation is inherited from selected-D door-matrix data, not clear opening or door-swing geometry.
Room connection goals are sample points 2.5ft beyond each room-block side, a schematic reachability proxy rather than a door or specified clearance.

The hall search checks a 4ft swept square on a 2in translation grid. It does not model walls, doors, swings, landings beyond the source connector, headroom, floor openings, stairs, structure, services, furniture or fire/life-safety.
The lift keepout is a plan projection from the source reservation; verify actual shaft and floor opening in Revit.
No Revit, IFC, code, accessibility, structural or construction validation is made. A search candidate is a room-block concept only.

The revised private-route-only direction excludes a direct U-03 shared-hall door; actual private and public openings remain unmodeled. Corridor proximity to U-03 is not evidence of a doorway. No room sizes or selected-D baseline are edited.
